“这他妈到底是什么东西......”

靳越手中的191步枪枪口还在冒着青烟，他迅速更换弹匣，拍下空仓挂机按钮，重新据枪瞄准。

一旁的徐峰面色凝重----就在刚刚，他们抵达徐鹤鸣家堂屋的那一刻，一场恶战便猝不及防地爆发了。

几乎在他们五人踏入院门的同时，棺材中原本窸窸窣窣响个不停的摩擦声戛然而止。

那棺材里的东西似乎察觉到了他们的到来，这个堂屋的气氛也骤然变得阴冷。

村子里仍然热闹着，远处传来老人喝骂玩水孩童的尖利声音，院子里的老榕树上，早醒的蝉凄厉地叫着。

风吹过，角落的一个黑色塑料袋被卷起，扑簌簌地从堂屋门口飞过。

也就在那一瞬间，一声沉闷的响声，从堂屋里那口棺材里响起。

似乎是有什么东西，从棺材里坐了起来。

它的头撞到了棺盖。

所有人都神情紧绷，靳越手里的191解开了保险，瞄准了棺材的方向。

另外三名队员也同时抽出了配发的92式手枪，拉动套筒上膛。

徐峰紧握出鞘的横刀，浑身的肌肉绷紧到了极致，稍稍站在了四名调研组队员的侧面。

他知道，如果冲突真的爆发，自己唯一能做的，就是尽可能阻止那东西近身。

贸然冲上前去，反而有可能挡住枪口，把自己先暴露在火线下。

气氛凝结到了冰点，所有人的视线都死死盯着那口棺材。

随后在某一刻，那根弦崩断了。

“砰！”

一声巨响，棺盖瞬间被掀飞。

就像徐家明描述的一样！

下一秒。

“砰砰砰砰-----”

连续不断的枪声响起，靳越毫不犹豫地扣下了扳机。

5.8毫米的钢芯穿甲弹携破空而去，它所携带的巨大威势，哪怕是一块钢板，都能轻易洞穿！

而它也确实轻而易举地洞穿了它的目标----那个浑身漆黑、干瘪、却又如同百年枯藤一般虬结的影子。

祠堂的墙壁上如同被雨水砸中的水面一般泛起涟漪，烟尘四起，而也就在这烟尘之中，那影子竟然顶着枪火，向众人直扑而来！

“停火让开！！”

徐峰大喊着抽刀，在靳越打空弹匣的瞬间扑了上去。

随后，一刀劈下！

锋刃划过，那影子的胸前被划出一道巨大的豁口，但它所携带的冲势却丝毫没有减弱。

轰然撞倒徐峰、又一脚踏过他的身体之后，影子冲入巷子，消失无踪。

反应过来的靳越立刻指挥队员放飞穿越机，同时根据飞手的指引带着剩余两名队员展开追击。

双溪村的建筑密集、道路复杂，哪怕是那个显然具有超高机动性的影子也被困在其中。

在高空视野的帮助下，靳越三次追上了影子，打空了三个弹匣，可最终，他还是没能留住对方。

等那影子终于翻过最后一道院墙、跳出村外、进入广袤的天地时，靳越也不得不停了下来。

追不上了！

后方，提着刀的徐峰也赶了上来......

"What the hell is this...?"

The muzzle of the 191 rifle in Jin Yue's hand was still emitting green smoke. He quickly changed the magazine, took the empty magazine hang-up button, and re-aimed the gun.

Xu Feng looked solemn on the side - just now, the moment they arrived at the main room of Xu Heming's house, a fierce battle broke out unexpectedly.

Almost at the same time that the five of them stepped into the courtyard, the incessant rustling and rubbing sounds in the coffin suddenly stopped.

The thing in the coffin seemed to be aware of their arrival, and the atmosphere in the main room suddenly became cold.

The village was still lively, with the sharp voices of old people scolding children playing in the water coming from the distance. On the old banyan tree in the yard, cicadas who had woken up early screamed shrilly.

The wind blew, and a black plastic bag in the corner was rolled up and flew past the door of the main room.

At that moment, a dull sound came from the coffin in the main room.

It seemed like something was sitting up from the coffin.

Its head hit the coffin lid.

Everyone looked tense. Jin Yue unlocked the safety of the 191 in his hand and aimed in the direction of the coffin.

The other three team members also pulled out the issued Type 92 pistols at the same time and pulled the slide to load the gun.

Xu Feng grasped the unsheathed sword tightly, his muscles tensed to the extreme, and stood slightly to the side of the four members of the research team.

He knew that if a conflict really broke out, the only thing he could do was to prevent that thing from getting close as much as possible.

If you rush forward rashly, you may block the muzzle of the gun and expose yourself to the line of fire first.

The atmosphere was frozen to freezing point, and everyone's eyes were fixed on the coffin.

Then at some point, the string snapped.

"Bang!"

There was a loud noise, and the coffin lid was blown away instantly.

Just like Xu Jiaming described!

The next second.

"Bang bang bang bang-----"

Continuous gunfire sounded, and Jin Yue pulled the trigger without hesitation.

The 5.8mm steel-core armor-piercing bullet pierced the air. It carried such huge power that it could easily penetrate even a steel plate!

And it indeed easily penetrated its target—that dark, shriveled shadow that was as knotted as a century-old dead vine.

Ripples appeared on the walls of the ancestral hall like water hit by rain, and smoke and dust were everywhere. And in the smoke and dust, the shadow actually faced the gunfire and rushed towards everyone!

"Cease fire and get out of the way!!"

Xu Feng shouted, drew his knife, and pounced on Jin Yue the moment he emptied the magazine.

Then, he slashed with a knife!

The sharp blade passed by, and a huge gap was made in the shadow's chest, but the momentum it carried did not weaken at all.

After knocking Xu Feng down suddenly and stepping on his body, the shadow rushed into the alley and disappeared without a trace.

After reacting, Jin Yue immediately commanded the team members to release the shuttle, and at the same time led the remaining two team members to pursue according to the pilot's instructions.

Shuangxi Village has dense buildings and complicated roads, and even the shadow that obviously has super high mobility is trapped in it.

With the help of high-altitude vision, Jin Yue caught up with Shadow three times and emptied three magazines, but in the end, he still failed to keep him.

When the shadow finally climbed over the last courtyard wall, jumped out of the village, and entered the vast world, Jin Yue had to stop.

Can't catch up!

From behind, Xu Feng, holding a knife, also caught up...
